subject: Recap + action map: FinTechX discovery (next steps & stakeholders)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer@fintechx.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 17:00:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + action map: FinTechX discovery (next steps & stakeholders)

Thanks again for the time today, Jennifer — appreciated the candid discussion. I promised a short recap and a proposed mutual action map (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, and target dates so we have a single source of truth. I attached a one-tab MAP (FinTechX_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 evidence summary we discussed.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Latency spikes on peak batch pricing jobs causing downstream reporting delays (~2–3x SLA breaches per week).
- Cost unpredictability from burst GPU spend and inability to route non-prod traffic to lower-cost variants.
- Auditability: need for token-level logs and retention for regulatory reporting (6+ months).

Goals from the vendor side you shared:
- < 150ms p50 for inference on key flows (summary generation) by end of pilot.
- Predictable cost runway for Q2, with a budget guardrail we can hit without manual throttles.
- Clear SOC2 evidence bundle and a simple procurement path (PO + simple MSA redlines).

Proposed MAP (first pass) — milestones, owner, target date:
1) Pilot kickoff & data checklist — Owner: Jennifer/FinTechX; Redwood lead: Marcus — Target: 2026-02-18
2) Security review (SOC2 artifacts + tech call) — Owner: FinTechX Security (Tom Lee); Redwood security: Grace — Target: 2026-02-24
3) Pilot performance run (2-week window) — Owner: Redwood infra + FinTechX platform — Target: 2026-03-10
4) Commercial & procurement (MSA review + PO) — Owner: FinTechX procurement; Redwood commercial: Monica — Target: 2026-03-17
5) Go/No-go decision & exec sign-off — Owner: Jennifer (FinTechX) + Redwood Sales Director — Target: 2026-03-24

Decision process notes:
- Technical sign-off: FinTechX Security (Tom) after SOC2 artifacts and a short technical walkthrough.
- Procurement: FinTechX prefers a PO-based close. Legal will only redline non-material items; pricing exceptions require exec approval.

Immediate next steps I will take:
- Send updated MAP (attached) with the dates above and a stub for the security call. (Marcus)
- Schedule a 45-min security walkthrough with Grace and Tom for 2/23 or 2/24 — will propose times after this note. (Grace)
- Provide a short cost-estimate and burst-control options for your budget review (Monica).

Please reply with any edits to owners or dates. If that looks good, Jen — would you be able to confirm Tom and the procurement contact for calendar invites?

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: FinTechX_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - MAP), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (summary - 2 pages)
From: Jennifer Park <jennifer@fintechx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@fintechx.com>, procurement@fintechx.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + action map: FinTechX discovery (next steps & stakeholders)

Thanks Marcus — solid recap and thanks for pulling that together. A few quick confirmations and one tweak from our side: 

1) Confirmed owners: Tom (security) will own the security review, and procurement@fintechx.com is the right procurement inbox. I will coordinate PO timing.
2) Dates look reasonable but can we move the security walkthrough to 2026-02-25 (Tom is booked 2/23-2/24)
3) For commercial, Legal will likely push back on indemnity language; procurement wants to see commercial terms before we escalate to Legal.

I copied Tom and procurement so they see the plan. Marcus — please confirm you can move the security slot to 2/25. Also, Monica — can you include a concrete example of burst-control (how quick we can throttle/route to cheaper variants) in the cost-estimate?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Jennifer Park
Head of Partnerships
FinTechX
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Recap + action map: FinTechX discovery (next steps & stakeholders)

Marcus — forwarding my notes after a quick sync with Security SME (internal). Pls incorporate before sending updated MAP to FinTechX.

Key security notes from SME:
- We can produce a SOC2 evidence bundle and a short technical memo covering token-level logging and retention — delivery ETA: 2 business days after confirmation of scope.
- Suggest we prepare a short demo showing prefix caching and routing to lower-cost model variants; this will help Tom see the concrete cost controls.
- For the security walkthrough we should include: (1) architecture diagram, (2) log retention policy, (3) sample audit logs (anonymized).

Commercial note to Monica: include a pricing carve-out that shows pilot vs projected production spend with and without burst controls. A small workbook that ties actions to expected monthly spend will help procurement sign off.

Attaching my suggested MAP edits into the spreadsheet (renamed sheet: MAP_v1_annotated).

-Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Security Partnerships (Redwood)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Park <jennifer@fintechx.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@fintechx.com>, procurement@fintechx.com, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP + proposed security call: FinTechX (confirm owners/dates)

Jennifer — thanks for the quick confirmation. Per Tom's availability note, we moved the security walkthrough to 2026-02-25 at 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite pending (Tom/procurement please accept when you can).

Attached: FinTechX_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP_v1_annotated) — summary of updates below:
- Security walkthrough moved to 2026-02-25, owner: Tom Lee (FinTechX), Redwood lead: Grace O'Connor.
- Commercial milestone: added "Provide PO-ready term summary" (Owner: FinTechX procurement; Redwood commercial: Monica) — target: 2026-03-12 to align with FinTechX legal review cadence.
- Pilot window unchanged (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-14).

Ask to FinTechX: please confirm acceptance of the MAP and the stakeholders below so we can lock the invites and Monica can share the cost workbook by EOD 2/12.

Stakeholders to confirm:
- Tech/Security: Tom Lee <tom.lee@fintechx.com>
- Procurement: procurement@fintechx.com
- Executive sponsor/decision: Jennifer Park <jennifer@fintechx.com>

If we get confirmation today/tomorrow we can keep the current cadence and have the PO/terms conversation before the end of the pilot.

Thanks — attaching the MAP and SOC2 summary again.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: FinTechX_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf
